entry.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware
entry.summary: German lawmakers and a filmmaker are among the people who received notifications from Apple warning that their phones may have been hacked.

entry.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
entry.summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

entry.title: Apple’s inventory surges 154% as memory chip costs climb
entry.summary: Apple says unprecedented memory chip costs will continue to rise, raising questions about future device prices as its inventory climbs to $14.5 billion.

entry.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
entry.summary: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

entry.title: Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve
entry.summary: Apple says iPhone Duo production is ramping up, but it still can't say when supply will catch up with demand as shipping delays stretch into next year.

entry.title: Hinge tests a cheaper plan as users become more fed up paying for dating apps
entry.summary: At a time when people are increasingly tired of dating apps, Hinge is testing a cheaper subscription plan.

entry.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
entry.summary: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

entry.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
entry.summary: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

entry.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
entry.summary: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

entry.title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
entry.summary: Google's Dreambeans, its latest AI experiment, now supports 13 Indian languages.

entry.title: Apple Watch’s AI features for rewinding and recapping conversations begin beta testing
entry.summary: Now in beta: Apple's new Audio Intelligence features can help you remember what someone said or take notes on conversations.

entry.title: Yvonne Bajela is bringing $17M in fresh capital to Europe’s startup scene

entry.summary: Secure your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass savings before prices increase tomorrow at 9 a.m. ET. Save up to $100 on your pass, and get a second for free.
